{{Top|leg}}
The '''dazer''' was an explosive weapon, developed by [[Jedi healer/Legends|Chief Healer]] [[Cilghal]], as part of an arsenal of devices that could be used against the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] hives of [[the Colony]]. When detonated, the dazer unleashed a brilliant display of lights and other sensory disruptions that deadened a Killik's aura and cut off a Killik's ability to commune with the rest of its hive. Many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] observed that dazers gave off a smell like freshly-cut [[Pallie/Legends|pallies]] when they exploded.
